remarks: Welcome to 700 Summer Street in the heart of vibrant, downtown Stamford. Experience city living at its finest in this impeccably designed 1 bedroom/1 bath with marble sink that offers the perfect blend of comfort and style. The beautifully renovated kitchen boasts wraparound marble countertops, stylish white cabinets and appliances, and subway tile backsplash that will delight the serious home chef. The floor plan features an open flow floor plan that savvy buyers are looking for today. Extra wide new waterproof flooring in Living Room, Dining area and bedroom. The sunny, generous sized living room leads to a private balcony to enjoy your morning coffee. And an ample size bedroom with 2 closets adds to the perfection. This secure entry building has been recently updated with beautifully designed common areas, and offers a range of amenities such as an on-site fitness center, a new laundry area and a lovely landscaped courtyard. One reserved indoor garage parking spot (#30), and the HOA covers heat, hot water and cooking gas. This location has unbeatable convenience, with easy access to I-95, and walking distance to great shopping, entertainment and gourmet restaurants. Close to Target, post office, Avon Theatre, train station, beach and green spaces. Everthing is walking distance or a 5 minute uber. It's a perfect condo if you are looking to owner occupy or purchase as an investment. Don't miss this chance to experience urban luxury living at its finest.
